mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right design and placement for a custom seating wall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right design involves considering your outdoor space's existing layout, your aesthetic preferences, and the wall's intended use. Think about flow, views, sun exposure, and how the wall will integrate with other features like fire pits or dining areas. We start with a comprehensive site assessment and discussion about your vision. Our design process includes sketches and material samples to help you visualize options and make informed decisions that optimize both beauty and functionality for your unique property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider existing layout, aesthetic, and intended use. Our design process involves site assessment, discussions, and visualizations to ensure optimal placement and design.
